title.narrative: Humanitarian mine action in Colombia NL MFA 2020-2024

description.narrative: The target groups for this project are communities suffering from the threat of landmines and other explosive remnants of war in Colombia.
This project aims to safe lives and increase livelihoods in Colombia by: 1) clearing landmines and other explosive items and 2) providing Explosive Ordnance Risk Education.

comment.narrative: To date, HALO has surpassed the overall EORE targets. As HALO recently resumed operations in Meta department, EORE has been a highly effective liaison tool for community engagement and frequently requested. Despite that, HALO expects to conduct more sessions in the following reporting period as communities in El Castillo and Puerto Rico municipalities have not been covered by EORE in the past. This increases their vulnerability as security conditions remain fragile, and the risk for landmine related accidents is latent.

comment.narrative: HALO has reached a significant number of children beneficiaries (boys and girls) compared to the initial target as the teams delivered eight sessions in schools in Puerto Lleras. The HALO EORE strategy always includes schools to reach at-risk children, as schools from the urban centre often bring together children from rural communitites nearby, which means they may be at risk as they travel from their homes to school. When HALO is new to a municipality, the standard deployment alwalys starts in the urban centre and slowly moves to rural areas in fragile contexts like Meta.

comment.narrative: To date, HALO has achieved 7% of the overall clearance target. This underachievement is due to the extensive logistics required to start deployment in the minefields within the inidgenous reservation of Mesetas. Although the deminers were hired as soon as the funds became available, they had to build their own camps from scratch, installing piping, electrical wiring and a number of enhancements needed for housing the three teams for the duration of the clearance intervention. Therefore, demining finally started on 30 May, which corresponds to only one month of operations to report. HALO plans to increase the number of teams deployed and increase productivity in the following months.
